newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia bans expatriates from working in seven fields.
- Over 19,000 beggars were arrested in one year in Saudi Arabia.
- The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency warned the public about attempts by gangs to forge Saudi currency notes.
- Saudi Aramco invested 15 billion riyals in a gas network expansion project.
- King Fahd decreed the expansion of Shura Council membership to 90 from 60.
